SND_TR_STM_STOCK_RECVDETAIL STM
         INNER JOIN snd_pr_prd_product PRD
                    ON PRD.porg_orgacode = STM.porg_orgacode
                        AND PRD.porp_princode = STM.porp_princode
                        AND PRD.pprd_prodcode = STM.pprd_prodcode
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m PRDM
                   ON PRD.porg_orgacode = PRDM.porg_orgacode
                       AND PRD.porp_princode = PRDM.porp_princode
                       AND PRD.pprd_prodcode = PRDM.pprd_prodcode
                       AND PRDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE STT
                   ON STM.PORG_ORGACODE = STT.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND STM.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE = STT.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE_M STTM
                   ON STT.PORG_ORGACODE = STTM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND STT.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE = STTM.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE
                       AND STTM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 bt
Left OUTER JOIN
snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy gh
    ON gh.porg_orgacode = bt.porg_orgacode AND gh.pgeo_geoghier_code = bt.pgeo_geoghier_code
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy_m ghl
    ON ghl.porg_orgacode = gh.porg_orgacode AND ghl.pgeo_geoghier_code = gh.pgeo_geoghier_code AND
       ghl.plng_langcode =  '@Session(languageCode)'
Left OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION PLOC ON
PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = bt.PORG_ORGACODE AND
PLOC.ploc_locacode = bt.ploc_locacode
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION_M PLOCM ON PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = PLOCM.PORG_ORGACODE

SND_EN_ICT_IO_CLAIM_TYPE_MAP CLMTP
                        INNER JOIN SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE PDTT
                                   ON CLMTP.porg_orgacode = PDTT.porg_orgacode AND
                                      CLMTP.eict_claim_type = PDTT.pdot_docmtype
                        LEFT JOIN snd_pr_dot_documenttype_m PDTTM
                                  ON PDTT.porg_orgacode = PDTTM.porg_orgacode AND
                                     PDTT.pdot_docmtype = PDTTM.pdot_docmtype
                                      AND PDTTM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                        INNER JOIN GLB_PR_ANC_ANLS_CLASIFY PANC
                                   ON CLMTP.porg_orgacode = PANC.porg_orgacode AND PANC.pant_analysis_category = 'CHNL'
                                       AND PANC.panc_analysis_class_code = CLMTP.pchh_chnlhier_code
                        LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_ANC_ANLS_CLASIFY_M PANCM
                                  ON PANC.porg_orgacode = PANCM.porg_orgacode
                                      AND PANC.pant_analysis_category = PANCM.pant_analysis_category AND
                                     PANC.pant_analysis_type = PANCM.pant_analysis_type AND
                                     PANC.panc_analysis_class_code = PANCM.panc_analysis_class_code
                                      AND PANCM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_EN_ORI_ORDER_INTEGRATION ORI
INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 EPP1
ON ORI.PORG_ORGACODE = EPP1.PORG_ORGACODE
AND ORI.EORI_DT_CODE = EPP1.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
LEFT JOIN SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1_M EPP1M
ON EPP1M.PORG_ORGACODE = EPP1.PORG_ORGACODE
and EPP1M.pbet_busentity_type= EPP1.pbet_busentity_type
AND EPP1M.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = EPP1.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
AND EPP1M.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_EN_OID_ORDR_INTGRTON_DTL OTD
INNER JOIN SND_EN_ORI_ORDER_INTEGRATION OT ON
OTD.eori_serial_no = OT.eori_serial_no

snd_en_pjp_pjphead_daily PD
inner join snd_en_pjp_pjphead PH on
PH.porg_orgacode=PD.porg_orgacode
and PH.pbet_busentity_type=PD.pbet_busentity_type
and PH.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code=PD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
AND PH.epjp_pjpno=PD.epjp_pjpno_daily
inner join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2 lvlDSR on
PD.porg_orgacode=lvlDSR.porg_orgacode
and PD.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl2_f=lvlDSR.pbet_busentity_type
and PD.epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_f=lvlDSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
and lvlDSR.pbet_busentity_type='DSRS'
inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 lvlWRHS on
lvlWRHS.porg_orgacode=PD.porg_orgacode
and lvlWRHS.pbet_busentity_type=PD.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b
and lvlWRHS.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code=PD.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b
and lvlWRHS.pbet_busentity_type='WRHS'

snd_en_pjp_pjphead_daily pd INNER JOIN snd_en_pjv_pjpvisit_daily vd ON pd.porg_orgacode = vd.porg_orgacode AND pd.pbet_busentity_type = vd.pbet_busentity_type AND pd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = vd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND pd.epjp_pjpno_daily = vd.epjp_pjpno_daily AND pd.epjp_sr_no_daily = vd.epjp_sr_no_daily INNER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 lvl1 ON lvl1.porg_orgacode = vd.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = vd.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c AND lvl1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = vd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c AND lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = 'OUTL' LEFT OUTER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_M lvl1M ON lvl1.porg_orgacode = lvl1M.porg_orgacode AND lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = lvl1M.pbet_busentity_type AND lvl1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = lvl1M.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND lvl1M.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)' INNER JOIN snd_en_pjp_pjphead PH ON PH.porg_orgacode = PD.porg_orgacode AND PH.pbet_busentity_type = PD.pbet_busentity_type AND PH.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = PD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND PH.epjp_pjpno = PD.epjp_pjpno_daily

result.tbl:
(
         select a.porg_orgacode                                                   orgaCode
              , a.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code                                       locationCode
              , a.epjp_pjpno
              , a.epjp_pjpno                                                      pjp
              , concat(a.epjp_pjpno, '-', a.epjp_desc)                            epjp_desc
              , concat(lvlDSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code, '-', lvlDSR.epp2_desc)   dsr
              , concat(lvlWRHS.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code, '-', lvlWRHS.epp1_desc) warehouse
              , b.epjp_sr_no_daily
              , b.epjp_journey_status
              , b.epjp_journey_start_time
              , b.epjp_journey_end_time
              , '@Model(workingDate)'                                             workingDate
              , DST.pdst_dsr_type
              , dst.pdst_nature_identifier
              , b.epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_f
              , a.MODIFIED_DATE AS                                                MODIFIED_DATE
              , b.epjp_dsr_file_status
         from snd_en_pjp_pjphead a
                  inner join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2 lvlDSR
                             on
                                     a.porg_orgacode = lvlDSR.porg_orgacode
                                     and a.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl2_f = lvlDSR.pbet_busentity_type
                                     and a.epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_f = lvlDSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
                                     and lvlDSR.pbet_busentity_type = 'DSRS'
                                     and a.porg_orgacode = '@Session(OrgaCode)' and
                                     a.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)'
                  inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 lvlWRHS on
                 lvlWRHS.porg_orgacode = a.porg_orgacode
                 and lvlWRHS.pbet_busentity_type = a.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b
                 and lvlWRHS.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = a.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b
                 and lvlWRHS.pbet_busentity_type = 'WRHS'
                  INNER JOIN snd_pr_dst_dsrtype DST ON DST.porg_orgacode = a.porg_orgacode
             AND DST.pdst_dsr_type = lvlDSR.pdst_dsr_type
             AND DST.pdst_dsr_type = '@Model(TXT__epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_fChild)'
                  left join snd_en_pjp_pjphead_daily b on
                 a.porg_orgacode = b.porg_orgacode
                 and a.pbet_busentity_type = b.pbet_busentity_type
                 and a.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = b.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                 AND a.epjp_pjpno = b.epjp_pjpno_daily
                 and b.epjp_working_date = '@Model(workingDate)'
     ) EE

snd_en_pjp_pjphead_daily pd
INNER JOIN snd_en_pjd_pjpdetail_daily pdd ON pdd.porg_orgacode = pd.porg_orgacode AND pdd.pbet_busentity_type = pd.pbet_busentity_type AND pdd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                     AND pdd.epjp_pjpno_daily = pd.epjp_pjpno_daily AND pdd.epjp_sr_no_daily = pd.epjp_sr_no_daily
INNER JOIN snd_en_pjv_pjpvisit_daily vd ON pd.porg_orgacode = vd.porg_orgacode AND pd.pbet_busentity_type = vd.pbet_busentity_type AND pd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = vd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                     AND pd.epjp_pjpno_daily = vd.epjp_pjpno_daily AND pd.epjp_sr_no_daily = vd.epjp_sr_no_daily
                     and pdd.epjd_srno_daily=vd.epjd_srno_daily
                     and pd.porg_orgacode ='@Session(OrgaCode)'
                     and pd.pbet_busentity_type='DIST'
                     and pd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code='@Session(DIST)'
                     and pd.epjp_pjpno_daily ='@Model(TXT__epjp_pjpno_dailyChild)'
                     and pd.epjp_sr_no_daily ='@Model(TXT__epjp_sr_no_daily)'
INNER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 lvl1 ON lvl1.porg_orgacode = vd.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = vd.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c AND lvl1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = vd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c AND lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = 'OUTL'
inner join snd_en_pl1_prf_bsen_log_lvl1 sc on sc.porg_orgacode =pdd.porg_orgacode_log_lvl1_k and sc.pbet_busentity_type=pdd.pbet_busent_type_log_lvl1_k and sc.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code=pdd.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_k
inner join snd_en_pl1_prf_bsen_log_lvl1 se on se.porg_orgacode =pdd.porg_orgacode_log_lvl1_l and se.pbet_busentity_type=pdd.pbet_busent_type_log_lvl1_l and se.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code=pdd.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l
LEFT OUTER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_M lvl1M ON lvl1.porg_orgacode = lvl1M.porg_orgacode AND lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = lvl1M.pbet_busentity_type AND lvl1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = lvl1M.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND lvl1M.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_PR_VCH_VEHICLE BT
  LEFT JOIN SND_PR_VCH_VEHICLE_M ML
    on BT.porg_orgacode = ML.porg_orgacode
      AND BT.pvch_vehicle_code = ML.pvch_vehicle_code
      AND plng_langcode =  '@Session(languageCode)'

(SELECT cmm.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE             AS DISTCODE,
        CONCAT(cmm.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE, ' - ',
        coalesce(distm.EPP1_DESC, dist.EPP1_DESC)) AS DISTDESC,
        cmm.TCMM_DOCNO                            AS DOCNO,
        cmm.PDOT_DOCMTYPE                         AS DOCTYPE,
        cmm.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS                       AS DOCSTATUS,
        cmm.PCUR_CURRCODE                         AS CURRENCY,
        cmm.EPP1_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL1_C           AS OUTLCODE,
        coalesce(pp1m.EPP1_DESC, pp1.EPP1_DESC)   AS OUTLDESC,
        cmm.TCMM_DOCM_DATE                        AS DOCMDATE,
        cmm.TCMM_DELIVERY_DATE                    AS DELIDATE,
        cmm.TCMM_REF_DOCNO                        AS REFDOCNO,
        cmm.porg_orgacode                         AS ORGACODE,
        pdot.pdot_nature_identifier               AS PDOTNATUREIDENTIFIER,
        pdos.pdos_nature_identifier               AS PDOSNATUREIDENTIFIER,
        cmm.pbet_busentity_type                   AS BUSENTTYPE,
        cmm.epjp_pjpno_daily                      AS PJPNUMBERDAILY,
        cmm.porg_orgacode_log_lvl1_l              AS SECTORGA,
        cmm.pbet_busent_type_log_lvl1_l           AS SECTTYPE,
        cmm.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l           AS SECTION,
        cmm.tcmm_stock_allocated_status           AS ALLOCATEDSTATUS,
        cmm.TCMM_NET_AMT_FCY                      AS NETAMT,
        COALESCE(cmtm.pcmt_desc, cmt.pcmt_desc)   AS OrderType,
        CMM.MODIFIED_DATE                         AS MODIFIED_DATE
 FROM snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cmm
          INNER JOIN snd_pr_dot_documenttype pdot
                     ON cmm.porg_orgacode = pdot.porg_orgacode
                         AND cmm.pdot_docmtype = pdot.pdot_docmtype
          INNER JOIN GLB_PR_EXS_EXECUTION_STATUS ES ON ES.PORG_ORGACODE = CMM.PORG_ORGACODE
     AND ES.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = CMM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
     AND ES.PEXS_EXECUTION_STATUS = CMM.PEXS_EXECUTION_STATUS
     AND ES.PEXS_IDENTIFIER = 'STL'
          INNER JOIN snd_pr_dos_documentstatus pdos
                     ON cmm.porg_orgacode = pdos.porg_orgacode
                         AND cmm.pdot_docmtype = pdos.pdot_docmtype
                         and cmm.pdos_docmstatus = pdos.pdos_docmstatus
          inner join glb_pr_cmt_cashmemo_type cmt
                     on cmt.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type = cmm.pcmt_cashmemo_type
          left join glb_pr_cmt_cashmemo_type_m cmtm
                    on cmtm.porg_orgacode = cmt.porg_orgacode and cmtm.pcmt_cashmemo_type = cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type and
                       cmtm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          INNER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1
                     ON cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c = pp1.porg_orgacode
                         AND cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c = pp1.pbet_busentity_type
                         AND cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c = pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1m
                    ON pp1.porg_orgacode = pp1m.porg_orgacode
                        AND pp1.pbet_busentity_type = pp1m.pbet_busentity_type
                        AND pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                        AND pp1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          INNER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 dist
                     ON cmm.porg_orgacode = dist.porg_orgacode
                         AND cmm.pbet_busentity_type = dist.pbet_busentity_type
                         AND cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = dist.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m distm
                    ON dist.porg_orgacode = distm.porg_orgacode
                        AND dist.pbet_busentity_type = distm.pbet_busentity_type
                        AND dist.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = distm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                        AND distm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)')

SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD PJP
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_OP1_OTH_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 PP1
                    ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PP1.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PP1.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                        AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PP1.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2 DSR
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJP.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE = PJP.EPP2_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL2_F
         INNER join snd_pr_dst_dsrtype DSRTYPE
                         ON DSR.porg_orgacode = DSRTYPE.porg_orgacode
                         and DSR.pdst_dsr_type = DSRTYPE.pdst_dsr_type
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2_M DSRM
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = DSRM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = DSRM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND DSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = DSRM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
                             AND DSRM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK BNK
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK_M BNKM
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = BNKM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNKM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNKM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH BNB
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = PJP.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH_M BNBM
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = BNBM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNBM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = BNBM.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
                             AND BNBM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD_M PJPM
                         ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PJPM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJPM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PJPM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                             AND PJP.EPJP_PJPNO = PJPM.EPJP_PJPNO
                             AND PJPM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

result.tbl:
(SELECT cmm.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE                     AS DISTCODE,
        CONCAT(cmm.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE, ' - ',
               coalesce(distm.EPP1_DESC, dist.EPP1_DESC)) AS DISTDESC,
        cmm.TCMM_DOCNO                                    AS DOCNO,
        cmm.PDOT_DOCMTYPE                                 AS DOCTYPE,
        cmm.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS                               AS DOCSTATUS,
        cmm.PCUR_CURRCODE                                 AS CURRENCY,
        cmm.EPP1_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL1_C                   AS OUTLCODE,
        coalesce(pp1m.EPP1_DESC, pp1.EPP1_DESC)           AS OUTLDESC,
        cmm.TCMM_DOCM_DATE                                AS DOCMDATE,
        cmm.TCMM_DELIVERY_DATE                            AS DELIDATE,
        cmm.TCMM_REF_DOCNO                                AS REFDOCNO,
        cmm.porg_orgacode                                 AS ORGACODE,
        pdot.pdot_nature_identifier                       AS PDOTNATUREIDENTIFIER,
        pdos.pdos_nature_identifier                       AS PDOSNATUREIDENTIFIER,
        cmm.pbet_busentity_type                           AS BUSENTTYPE,
       cmm.epjp_pjpno_daily                              AS PJPNUMBERDAILY,
        cmm.porg_orgacode_log_lvl1_l                      AS SECTORGA,
        cmm.pbet_busent_type_log_lvl1_l                   AS SECTTYPE,
        cmm.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l                   AS SECTION,
        cmm.tcmm_stock_allocated_status                   AS ALLOCATEDSTATUS,
        cmm.TCMM_NET_AMT_FCY                              AS NETAMT,
        COALESCE(cmtm.pcmt_desc, cmt.pcmt_desc)           AS OrderType,
        CMM.MODIFIED_DATE                                 AS MODIFIED_DATE
FROM snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cmm
          inner join glb_pr_exs_execution_status gpees on
                     gpees.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                     gpees.pdot_docmtype = cmm.pdot_docmtype and
                     gpees.pexs_execution_status = cmm.pexs_execution_status and
                     gpees.pexs_identifier = 'ALC'
          INNER JOIN snd_pr_dot_documenttype pdot
                     ON cmm.porg_orgacode = pdot.porg_orgacode
                         AND cmm.pdot_docmtype = pdot.pdot_docmtype
          INNER JOIN snd_pr_dos_documentstatus pdos
                     ON cmm.porg_orgacode = pdos.porg_orgacode
                         AND cmm.pdot_docmtype = pdos.pdot_docmtype
                         and cmm.pdos_docmstatus = pdos.pdos_docmstatus
                         AND cmm.porg_orgacode = '@Session(OrgaCode)'
                         AND cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)'
                         AND pdot.pdot_nature_identifier = 'CM'
                         AND pdos.pdos_nature_identifier = 'PLD'
                         AND cmm.tcmm_stock_allocated_status is not null
                         AND (cast(cmm.TCMM_DOCM_DATE AS DATE) = '@Model(DOCMDATE)')
                         AND cmm.epjp_pjpno_daily = '@Model(PJPNUMBERDAILY)'
                         AND cmm.porg_orgacode_log_lvl1_l = '@Session(OrgaCode)'
                         AND cmm.pbet_busent_type_log_lvl1_l = 'SECT'
                         AND cmm.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l = '@Model(SECTION)'
          inner join glb_pr_cmt_cashmemo_type cmt
                     on cmt.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                        cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type = cmm.pcmt_cashmemo_type
          INNER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1
                     ON cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c = pp1.porg_orgacode
                         AND cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c = pp1.pbet_busentity_type
                         AND cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c = pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
               inner join snd_en_op1_oth_bsen_phs_lvl1 oth on
          oth.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
          oth.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type and
         oth.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          INNER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 dist
                     ON cmm.porg_orgacode = dist.porg_orgacode
                         AND cmm.pbet_busentity_type = dist.pbet_busentity_type
                         AND cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = dist.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                         and coalesce(oth.eop1_ref_val_10, 'N') <> 'N'
          inner join snd_en_pjp_pjphead pj on
         pj.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode
         and pj.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type
         and pj.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         and pj.epjp_pjpno = cmm.epjp_pjpno_daily
         and coalesce(pj.epjp_planned_by, 'N') <> 'N'
         LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1m
                    ON pp1.porg_orgacode = pp1m.porg_orgacode
                        AND pp1.pbet_busentity_type = pp1m.pbet_busentity_type
                        AND pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                        AND pp1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         left join glb_pr_cmt_cashmemo_type_m cmtm
                    on cmtm.porg_orgacode = cmt.porg_orgacode and
                       cmtm.pcmt_cashmemo_type = cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type and
                       cmtm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m distm
                    ON dist.porg_orgacode = distm.porg_orgacode
                        AND dist.pbet_busentity_type = distm.pbet_busentity_type
                        AND dist.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = distm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                        AND distm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
) x

(select CM.porg_orgacode               as ORGACODE,
             CM.pbet_busentity_type         as BUSTYPE,
             CM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code   as BUSTPHLVL1,
             CM.pdot_docmtype               as DOCTYPE,
             CM.tcmm_docno                  as DOCNO,
             coalesce(OUTLM.EPP1_DESC,
                      OUTL.EPP1_DESC)       as OUTLETCODENAME,
             CM.pdos_docmstatus             as DOCST1,
             STSM.PDOS_DESC                 as STSNAME,
             EXS.pexs_execution_status      as pexs_execution_status,
             EXS.pexs_desc                  as pexs_desc,
             cast(TCMM_DOCM_DATE as DATE)   as DOCMDT,
             CM.TCMM_NET_AMT_FCY            as NETAMTFCY,
             CM.EPL1_BUSENT_CODE_LOG_LVL1_L as BUSCODLOGLVL1,
             CM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY            as PJPNODLY,
             CM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY_DELIVERY   as PJPNODLYDLV,
             CM.TCMM_DELIVERY_DATE          as DLVDT,
             '@Model(DELIVERYDATE)'         as DELIVERYDATE,
             CM.MODIFIED_DATE               as MODIFIED_DATE,
             CONCAT(
                     CM.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE,
                     ' - ',
                     CMT.PCMT_DESC
                 )                          as CASHMEMO_TYPE
              ,
             cmref.tcmr_refdocno               GIN_NO,
             cmref.tcmr_refdoctype             REFDOCTYPE,
             case when '@Model(reason)' = 'null' then '' else  '@Model(reason)' end              AS reason
      from SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_MASTER CM
               inner join SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 OUTL on
              CM.PORG_ORGACODE = OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE
              and CM.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE
              and CM.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
              and CM.EPP1_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
               inner join SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1_M OUTLM on
              OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE = OUTLM.PORG_ORGACODE
              and OUTL.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = OUTLM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
              and OUTL.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = OUTLM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
              and OUTLM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
               inner join SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS STS on
              CM.PORG_ORGACODE = STS.PORG_ORGACODE
              and CM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = STS.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
              and CM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = STS.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
               inner join SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS_M STSM on
              STS.PORG_ORGACODE = STSM.PORG_ORGACODE
              and STS.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = STSM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
              and STS.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = STSM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
              and STSM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
               inner join SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE dtype on
              cm.porg_orgacode = dtype.porg_orgacode
              and cm.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dtype.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
               inner join GLB_PR_EXS_EXECUTION_STATUS EXS on
              CM.porg_orgacode = EXS.porg_orgacode
              and CM.pdot_docmtype = EXS.pdot_docmtype
              and CM.pexs_execution_status = EXS.pexs_execution_status
               inner join snd_en_pjp_pjphead P on
              P.porg_orgacode = CM.porg_orgacode
              and P.pbet_busentity_type = CM.pbet_busentity_type
              and P.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
              and P.epjp_pjpno = CM.epjp_pjpno_daily_delivery
              and CM.tcmm_delivery_date >= P.epjp_working_date
               inner join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_refinfo cmref on
              cmref.porg_orgacode = cm.porg_orgacode and cmref.pbet_busentity_type = cm.pbet_busentity_type
              and cmref.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
              cmref.pdot_docmtype = cm.pdot_docmtype
              and cmref.tcmm_docno = cm.tcmm_docno
              and cmref.tcmr_status='1'
               inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                          on dt.porg_orgacode = cmref.porg_orgacode and dt.pdot_docmtype = cmref.tcmr_refdoctype
                              and dt.pdot_nature_identifier = 'GN' and cmref.porg_orgacode = '@Session(OrgaCode)' and
                             cmref.pbet_busentity_type = 'DIST'
                              and cmref.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)'
               inner join snd_tr_gnm_gingrn_master g on g.porg_orgacode = cmref.porg_orgacode
          and g.pbet_busentity_type = cmref.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                        g.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmref.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          and g.tgnm_docno = cmref.tcmr_refdocno
          and g.pdot_docmtype = cmref.tcmr_refdoctype and g.tgnm_status = 'A'
               left outer join GLB_PR_CMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE CMT on
              CM.PORG_ORGACODE = CMT.PORG_ORGACODE
              and CM.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE = CMT.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE

(select CM.porg_orgacode               as ORGACODE,
             CM.pbet_busentity_type         as BUSTYPE,
             CM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code   as BUSTPHLVL1,
             CM.pdot_docmtype               as DOCTYPE,
             CM.tcmm_docno                  as DOCNO,
             coalesce(OUTLM.EPP1_DESC,
                      OUTL.EPP1_DESC)       as OUTLETCODENAME,
             CM.pdos_docmstatus             as DOCST1,
             STSM.PDOS_DESC                 as STSNAME,
             EXS.pexs_execution_status      as pexs_execution_status,
             EXS.pexs_desc                  as pexs_desc,
             cast(TCMM_DOCM_DATE as DATE)   as DOCMDT,
             cast(TCMM_DOCM_DATE as DATE)   as OrderDate,
             CM.TCMM_NET_AMT_FCY            as NETAMTFCY,
             CM.EPL1_BUSENT_CODE_LOG_LVL1_L as BUSCODLOGLVL1,
             CM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY            as PJPNODLY,
             CM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY_DELIVERY   as PJPNODLYDLV,
             CM.TCMM_DELIVERY_DATE          as DLVDT,
             '@Model(DELIVERYDATE)'         as DELIVERYDATE,
            CM.tcmm_schdelv_date AS ACTUALDELIVERYDATE,
             CM.MODIFIED_DATE               as MODIFIED_DATE,
             CONCAT(
                     CM.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE,
                     ' - ',
                     CMT.PCMT_DESC
                 )                          as CASHMEMO_TYPE,
             CM.TCMM_REF_NO                 AS TCMM_REF_NO

      from SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_MASTER CM
               inner join SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 OUTL on
              CM.PORG_ORGACODE = OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE
              and CM.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE
              and CM.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
              and CM.EPP1_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL1_C = OUTL.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
               LEFT join SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1_M OUTLM on
              OUTL.PORG_ORGACODE = OUTLM.PORG_ORGACODE
              and OUTL.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = OUTLM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
              and OUTL.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = OUTLM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
              and OUTLM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
               inner join SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS STS on
              CM.PORG_ORGACODE = STS.PORG_ORGACODE
              and CM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = STS.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
              and CM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = STS.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
               LEFT join SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS_M STSM on
              STS.PORG_ORGACODE = STSM.PORG_ORGACODE
              and STS.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = STSM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
              and STS.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = STSM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
              and STSM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
               inner join SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE dtype on
              cm.porg_orgacode = dtype.porg_orgacode
              and cm.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dtype.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
               inner join GLB_PR_EXS_EXECUTION_STATUS EXS on
              CM.porg_orgacode = EXS.porg_orgacode
              and CM.pdot_docmtype = EXS.pdot_docmtype
              and CM.pexs_execution_status = EXS.pexs_execution_status
               inner join snd_en_pjp_pjphead P on
              P.porg_orgacode = CM.porg_orgacode
              and P.pbet_busentity_type = CM.pbet_busentity_type
              and P.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
              and P.epjp_pjpno = CM.epjp_pjpno_daily_delivery
              and CM.tcmm_delivery_date >= P.epjp_working_date
               left outer join GLB_PR_CMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE CMT on
              CM.PORG_ORGACODE = CMT.PORG_ORGACODE
              and CM.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE = CMT.PCMT_CASHMEMO_TYPE

result.tbl:
FIN_TR_RCOA_TRANSACTIONS T
left join FIN_PR_RCOA_ACCOUNT_SETUP A
                   on
	T.PORG_ORGACODE = A.PORG_ORGACODE
and
                      T.PRCA_TYPE = A.PRCA_TYPE
and
                      T.PRCA_CODE = A.PRCA_CODE
left join FIN_PR_RCOA_ACTIVITYCONTROL AC
                   on
	T.PORG_ORGACODE = AC.PORG_ORGACODE
and
                      T.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = AC.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
and
                      T.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = AC.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
and
                      T.PFQY_FREQUENCY = AC.PFQY_FREQUENCY
and
                      T.TRCA_PERIOD_NO = AC.PRAC_PERIOD_NO
left join FIN_PR_RCOA_TYPE ACT
                   on
	T.PORG_ORGACODE = ACT.PORG_ORGACODE
and
                      T.PRCA_TYPE = ACT.PRCA_TYPE
left join FIN_PR_RCOA_UOM UOM
                   ON T.PORG_ORGACODE = UOM.PORG_ORGACODE AND
                      T.PRCA_UOM_CODE = UOM.PRCA_UOM_CODE
